summary: Executed backend regression + mobile-web archive QA on public preview. Backend mirrors streaming suite passed (6/6). Frontend archive redesign loads with correct default totals (300 codes / 22 collections) and A–Z/search basics, but critical interaction regressions remain in archive play/load and Home modal integration flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Tap on archive play buttons in A–Z/search views repeatedly failed to activate now-playing/readout in automation runs.
Load action was unreliable; in successful click path lab did not open/staged label did not appear (no archive-lab-loaded-name).
From no-result state, RESET FILTERS left count at 0 CODES instead of restoring default collection/count context.

integration_issues.flow: Home -> open archive modal -> close while search focused
integration_issues.issue: Observed close behavior inconsistency; modal screen remained present in DOM checks after close attempt in one successful open run.

integration_issues.flow: Home archive explicit Load -> update Home Lab
integration_issues.issue: Explicit load path did not produce verifiable Home loaded banner/readout in tested run.

issues: At 320px width, horizontal alphabet strip appears crowded and near-edge clipped visually for later letters (functional scroll exists but readability/tap comfort is tight).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing warnings observed: expo-av deprecation, pointerEvents/shadow prop deprecations, missing native animated module fallback, responder handler warnings on web.

action_items: Fix archive entry tap reliability for play/stop in A–Z and search result contexts.
Fix archive load-arrow behavior so selecting archive-load-* consistently stages to shared Codes Lab and visibly switches to/open Lab with loaded label.
Fix Home archive modal close + explicit load close/update path (focused-search close and handleArchiveLoadFrequency integration).
Revalidate reset-filters behavior to restore default CODEX collection state/count.
After fixes, rerun mobile viewport QA at 375/390/320 and repeat backend mirrors streaming regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Archive module cleanly reuses shared state via useSyncExternalStore in archiveSession and keeps IDs prefixed by passed prefix (archive-* vs home-archive-*).
No voice/recording/transcription/permission UI added in tested archive files (grep across archive + library + home matched none).
Potential standards mismatch: codebase and tests currently use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL named in infra guidance); keep aligned with project env contract to avoid drift.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (core rendering/count/search mostly pass; critical play/load/modal integration failures)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not spend extra cycles on archive-load-* selector retries without first stabilizing list scroll/state; loop-prevention reached on repeated load/play selector failures. Start with /library: validate archive-play-* and archive-load-* from CODEX and A–Z states, then Home modal close/load behaviors. Existing screenshots + console logs are in /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter13 and /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260909_*.
rca_of_issue: Likely interaction-layer regression in ArchiveEntry touch targets/gesture handling after redesign: play/load handlers are present in source but behavior is inconsistent in Expo web runtime under filtered/alpha states. Reproduction: /library -> A–Z INDEX -> search 432 or 174 -> tap archive-play-* (no now-playing) and tap archive-load-* (no lab transition/loaded label). Home integration also shows inconsistent modal close/load completion from archive overlay when search is focused.
